## Observations

- Raising `compaction_token_trigger` from 28K to 64K alongside `step_limit: 250` jumped `solo` pass rate from 2/10 (`20%` in `steps250` at 28K) to **7/10 (`70%`)** at nearly the same total cost (`$19.63` vs. `$18.75`). Every agent that submitted passed both features (`7/7` submitted in `96` to `229` steps across `2` to `8` compactions), matching `coop --git` at 250 steps / 28K (`8/10`, `$19.87`) once the 2-feature `solo` agent has roughly the same active context (`64K`) as two single-feature `coop` peers (`2 x 28K = 56K`).
- All 3 failures hit `LimitsExceeded` at step 250 with `patch_lines == 0`: `pillow_task/290` (`6` compactions) had edited both `src/PIL/Image.py` and `Tests/test_image_quantize.py` and ran `git status` and `git diff` right before step 250 stopped it, while `dspy_task/8394` (`22` compactions) and `pallets_jinja_task/1559` (`18` compactions) repeatedly dumped large command outputs (up to `185K` prompt tokens) and never reached editing.
- Concurrency at `-c 4` (4 concurrent 64K agents) matched our input-TPM model cleanly: peak `1,083,103` input tokens/min with only `1` `429` retry, `0` `5xx` retries, and `0` agent errors across 128 minutes.
